paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across various categories within the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis represents categories, labeled as Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs, proceeding from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled 'Sentences' and represents the count of sentences, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 902, and tick labels incrementing by 100. There are eight bars, each corresponding to a category, displayed in shades of red and blue. The shortest bar, blue in color and representing Blogs, has an approximate height corresponding to 2 sentences. The next tallest bar is Science (blue), with an approximate height corresponding to 110 sentences. Following this are News (blue), with an approximate height corresponding to 190 sentences, and Law (red), with an approximate height of 35 sentences. The remaining bars are red: Fiction has an approximate height of 50 sentences, Non-fiction has an approximate height of 190 sentences, Religion has an approximate height of 525 sentences, and Administrative has an approximate height of 800 sentences. The bars are sorted from left to right according to the category labels.
